title: Parrot: Efficient Serving of LLM-based Applications with Semantic Variable
authors: Chaofan Lin; Zhenhua Han; Chengruidong Zhang; Yuqing Yang; Fan Yang; Chen Chen; Lili Qiu
venue_full: USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Performance modeling, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM services are request-centric and lack application-level knowledge, leading to sub-optimal end-to-end performance due to excessive network overhead, misaligned scheduling objectives, and redundant computations. This causes high latency and reduced throughput for complex LLM-based applications.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 服務以請求為中心，缺乏應用層知識，因而產生過多網路開銷、不一致的 scheduling 目標與冗餘計算，導致複雜 LLM 應用的端到端效能欠佳，延遲偏高且吞吐量受限。

key_innovation.en: Semantic Variable, a unified abstraction that exposes application-level knowledge (prompt structure and request correlations) to the LLM service, enabling data flow analysis, inter-request optimization, and application-centric scheduling.
key_innovation.zh: Semantic Variable 是一種統一抽象，將應用層知識（prompt 結構與請求關聯性）暴露給 LLM 服務，從而實現資料流分析、跨請求最佳化與以應用為中心的 scheduling。

key_improvements.en: Up to 11.7x speedup and 12x higher throughput compared to state-of-the-art solutions.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於最先進方案，速度最高提升 11.7x，吞吐量最高提升 12x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Data Analytics on Long Documents, Multi-agent Programming, Chat Service
traffic_pattern: Chain-style workflow, Map-Reduce style workflow, Multi-agent conversation
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 (80GB), NVIDIA A6000 (48GB), AMD EPYC-7V13, AMD EPYC CPU
comm_libraries: FastAPI, PyTorch, Transformers, CUDA, cuDNN, xFormers
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (no MAPE; reports end-to-end speedup against vLLM/FastChat)
models_validated: LLaMA-2-13B, LLaMA-2-7B, Vicuna-13B, CodeLlama, MetaGPT-style workflows
validation_workloads: Synthetic (Map-Reduce summarization, chain-of-thought, multi-agent programming, chat service)

scope_assumptions.en: Workflow DAG must be exposed to the serving layer through Semantic Variables; the scheduler optimizes across requests but does not produce per-request latency *predictions*. Performance model is application-aware but the paper does not publish a closed-form latency calculus for arbitrary workflow graphs.
scope_assumptions.zh: 工作流程 DAG 須透過 Semantic Variable 暴露給服務層；scheduler 跨請求進行最佳化，但並未產生 per-request 的延遲預測。效能模型具備應用感知能力，但論文並未針對任意工作流圖提出 closed-form 的延遲計算式。
